headline: 2027 Budget, Pensions: How Much the Revaluation Costs. Hypothesis of a "No Tax Area" for Under 35s
summary: Italian pensions will require 15 billion euros more next year than current spending, according to the budget discussion. A hypothetical 'no tax area' for under-35s is also under consideration.
why: Italy's budget sets public spending and tax policy for the euro area's third-largest economy, which shapes its deficit path and government bond supply. Pension costs are a major driver of that spending.
